gaps.note: Geist 12/400

gaps.title: Checkboxes filled with the field surface

gaps.standin: a clear box (the page shows through in dark: Geist's radio ΔE 0.145

gaps.note: title (14/500) and description both in blue-900 #0068d6, against ink and gray-900 when not selected
gaps.standin: `cardSelected: outline-tint` tints the fill and edge; the text stays in ink and muted ink

gaps.title: Choice card radio at the end, centered vertically
gaps.standin: the indicator at the start of the card

gaps.title: Slider thumb as a small light bar
gaps.note: 6×14, white, 1px corners, over an 8px track (gray-200 #ebebeb / #1f1f1f, blue-700 fill)
gaps.standin: `sliderThumb: knob` (a light disc); `handle` is a tall bar in the fill color that cuts the track

gaps.title: Switch size apart from density
gaps.note: Geist 28×14, 11px knob, no knob shadow

gaps.title: Off switch track in its own tone, filled inside an outline or not
gaps.note: Geist a pale solid gray-200 (#ebebeb / #2e2e2e), no ring
gaps.standin: ΔE 0.059 / 0.053 on Geist, 0.069 on Stripe, 0.080 / 0.142 on Supabase)

gaps.title: Tab padding apart from density
gaps.note: Geist 2px on 50px

gaps.title: Progress fill with a round leading end
gaps.note: Geist's gray-1000 fill keeps the 6px corners of its 10px track (gray-200 #ebebeb / #1f1f1f)
gaps.standin: `tracks: round` rounds the track, but the fill is a square bar clipped by it, so its leading end is square (Geist's `progressTrackStyle: plain` too: 0px at the fill's leading end)

gaps.title: Segmented items or track at the button height, flush or padded
gaps.note: Geist a 36px track, the button height (`--ds-size-medium`), padded 4px around 28px items with 12px inline padding
gaps.standin: 40px with 34px items and a 32px chip on Geist at comfortable

gaps.title: Segmented corners on their own rung
gaps.note: Geist's track at 6px, the control radius, under 12px menus and modals
gaps.standin: the segmented control takes the container radius from `roleSurface`: 8px with a 5px chip on Radix and Untitled UI, 0px under Carbon's `none`, 12px at GitHub's and Geist's `xl` (9px items on GitHub), 16px with 13px chips at Airbnb's `md`, 10.5px with a 7.5px chip on Wise, 12 / 9 / 9px on Claude; raising it rounds menus and popovers too

gaps.title: Segmented track filled and edged together
gaps.note: Geist's track on background-100 (#fff / #0a0a0a), the raised surface, inside a 1px gray-alpha-400 ring
gaps.standin: `outline` adds the edge but clears the track (Geist ΔE 0.145 in dark, where the page shows through)

gaps.title: Flat segmented chip, a pale tone or the page color with no shadow
gaps.note: Geist's selected item on gray-100 (#f2f2f2 / #1a1a1a), 4px corners
gaps.standin: `segmentedSelected: tone` adds a small drop shadow, and a darker chip on Geist (oklch 0.908 / 0.303; ΔE 0.053 / 0.085); The catalog credits Geist with the shadow

gaps.title: Segmented items at their own weight, apart from tabs
gaps.note: Geist's segmented items at 14/500, at rest and selected, while its line tabs stay 14/400
gaps.standin: on Geist `regular` puts both at 400, `medium` would put the tabs at 500

gaps.title: Light-mode ink lightness, darker or lighter than `fg`. Darker: Geist gray-1000 #171717 (L 0.20) for text, primary buttons and checked boxes; Untitled UI neutral-900 #171717 for values and headings; Carbon #161616 (see the text ink row); Supabase oklch 0.10 for headings, field values, checked boxes and the current nav row and tab; Spotify pure #000 on headings, labels, fields, tabs, links, tooltips and menus; ChatGPT gray-1000 #0d0d0d (L 0.17) for text, headings, field values, menu rows, badges and the selected day, its primary buttons, checks and on switch a step lighter on gray-900 #181818; Wise `content-primary` #0e0f0c (oklch 0.166) for headings, labels and field values; Claude #0b0b0b (oklch 0.150) for text, headings, menu rows, the primary fill and the tooltip. Lighter: Polaris #303030 (L 0.31) for text and the charcoal fills (primary buttons, checks, switches); Duolingo #3c3c3c (L 0.36) for headings and body; Notion #2c2c2b (L 0.29) for text, headings, buttons, menus, cards and the light tooltip
gaps.standin: `fg` at L 0.24 (Geist ΔE 0.037, the most common off row on Vercel

gaps.title: Text ink in more than one step
gaps.note: Geist field values in pure #000 / #fff (`--geist-foreground`) while text, buttons and labels take gray-1000 #171717 / #ededed
gaps.standin: Geist values 0.241 / 0.043

gaps.title: Muted ink lightness, darker or lighter than `fg-muted`. Darker: Material 3 on-surface-variant #49454f / #cac4d0 for inactive tabs, drawer labels and supporting text; Geist gray-900 #4d4d4d / #a1a1a1 for inactive tabs, keycaps, modal subtitles and descriptions; GitHub in dark only, `fgColor-muted` #9198a1 (L 0.68) for supporting text and keycap labels (light #59636e matches); Higgsfield, dark only, text-secondary #828282 (L 0.61) and muted text #898a8b (L 0.63), text-tertiary #626262 (L 0.50) on idle underline tabs, #8f8f90 segmented items; Stripe's Dashboard secondary text and resting settings tabs in slate-700 #3C4F69 (oklch ≈ 0.43). Lighter: Duolingo wolf #777777 (L 0.57) in light, and in dark #dce6ec, a step under the #f1f7fb headings, where it doesn't dim body copy (shop descriptions, idle nav and menu rows). Nearer mid-gray in both modes: Airbnb #6c6c6c / #a6a6a6; Notion #7d7a75 (L 0.58) / #ada9a3 (L 0.74) for inactive view tabs and section labels; Claude one muted #898781 (oklch 0.623) in both modes for idle pill tabs, section labels and the sidebar search placeholder. Further from mid-gray in both modes: Wise #454745 (L 0.395) / #e8ebe6 (L 0.936) for idle tabs and secondary text; ChatGPT's signed-in app #5d5d5d / #cdcdcd for secondary text (the Apps SDK library's dark step is #afafaf)
Inverse surfaces a step off the ink
